verdict.rationale: Mailchimp publishes a well-documented public Marketing API and Transactional API with detailed endpoints (contacts, campaigns, webhooks, exports, IP requests) and dedicated developer docs sites, enabling programmatic/agentic control of the product. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of API rate limits, OAuth scopes, or SDKs for AI-agent orchestration, and no independent hands-on developer corroboration of API robustness.
